title: UPI virtual address in a response
description: A UPI virtual payment address appears in the response body. A virtual address plus a name is a complete payment instruction on the instant-payment rail, and it is quoted in scam messages to make a collect request look legitimate.
remediation: Mask the handle in list views and show it only inside the authenticated payee screen.
limitation: One response body, first 32,768 bytes. It matches the handle suffix of a known UPI provider; it cannot tell whether the value behind the marker is live or whether the page needs authentication.
scopeT: A response body that carries a UPI virtual payment address.
fp: A page that explains the UPI format with a placeholder is still reported; confirm the value is a sample.
recordDesc: A UPI virtual payment address in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A virtual address plus a name is a complete payment instruction on the instant-payment rail, and it is quoted in scam messages to make a collect request look legitimate.
applicability: Deployments that render a UPI virtual payment address into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A virtual address plus a name is a complete payment instruction on the instant-payment rail, and it is quoted in scam messages to make a collect request look legitimate.
why: The marker exists for the build or administrator and answers a question an attacker would otherwise have to guess.
fix: Mask the handle in list views and show it only inside the authenticated payee screen.
Return a masked handle outside the payee detail screen.
verifyT: Request the page again and confirm the response no longer carries a UPI virtual payment address.
